description: inbox.unack brings a hidden item back to the default view: one more append-only marker row (undoing never edits or deletes the ack it undoes — P3), and the answer is the item again with no `acked` state. An unack of an item that was not hidden is a no-op that writes NO row and answers with nothing; the idempotence is silence, not an error.

door.sentence: Answer with `aeon answer refactor-auth <one of: approve | deny>` or in the app.
